basic_profile.bio: I'm a 31-year-old bass guitarist living in Portland, Oregon, enjoying the creative and eclectic vibe of the city. I work as an audio engineer and spend my days mixing tracks and my evenings jamming with local bands. I'm 6'6", so finding clothes that fit right is a constant challenge, which is why I frequent tallfashionadvice. In my downtime, I enjoy solving puzzles like Pokemon Picross and delving into the lore of Warhammer's Ossiarch Bonereapers. I live with my partner and our two cats. Typically online late at night, I appreciate the quiet hours to catch up on my favorite shows like BoJack Horseman.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in Audio Production and have been in the music industry for over a decade. My expertise spans sound editing for TV and film, and I have a particular interest in the nuanced sound design that enhances storytelling, like in shows such as The Sopranos.
